subject: ECO
body: Scarcity can best be described as
options: a tax paid directly to government by the person on whom it is imposed
short-term unemployment of people moving between jobs
limited resources relative to unlimited wants
man-made resources used in further production
explanation: Scarcity: limited resources relative to unlimited wants.

subject: ECO
body: Opportunity cost can best be described as
options: inflation caused by rising costs of production
an economy where both private and public sectors own and control resources
producing a good at a lower opportunity cost than another country
explanation: Opportunity cost: the next best alternative forgone.

subject: ECO
body: Scale of preference can best be described as
options: a list of wants arranged in order of importance
a maximum price fixed by government
the need for each party in a trade to want what the other has
a market with a single seller of a product with no close substitutes
explanation: Scale of preference: a list of wants arranged in order of importance.

subject: ECO
body: Effective demand can best be described as
options: desire backed by the ability and willingness to pay
the buying and selling of government securities by the central bank
the price at which quantity demanded equals quantity supplied
a tax that takes a larger share of income from the poor than the rich
explanation: Effective demand: desire backed by the ability and willingness to pay.

subject: ECO
